title: Hearing on seaplanes, party boats and ferry service expansion
summary: The Council will examine safety and oversight of seaplanes and excursion ('party') boats on NYC's waterways, as well as the future of NYC Ferry service, including costs, subsidies and ridership. The hearing also covers four bills proposing new ferry service at Canarsie Pier, Willets Point, West 125th Street and City Island. Documents cite recent safety incidents, including a fatal capsizing near Liberty Island in August 2026 and a fatal boat explosion off City Island in June 2025, and note NYC Ferry's base fare rose to $5.00 on October 19, 2026.
